fato_historico: 1986: In Istanbul, two terrorists from Abu Nidal's organization kill 22 and wound six congregants inside the Neve Shalom Synagogue during Shabbat services.
energia_do_dia: Today, your spirit may seek deep sanctuary amidst the noise of the world. Just as a flicker of light can bring warmth to the shadows of a historic place, consider how your presence offers comfort to others. It is a good time to ground yourself, nurture your inner peace, and cherish the safety of your own sacred space.
frase_do_dia: May your heart be a home where peace always finds a place to rest.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of your most beautiful and grounded dreams.
conselho: Protect your energy today by choosing calm environments and gentle conversations with dear friends.
